name: hero-digital-success
title: Hero Digital Success
description: A full-screen dark hero with a moving blue gradient wash, a split-colour headline, two pill buttons, a short pitch and a frosted grid of service labels.
use: A digital agency landing page needs an immediate statement with a moving blue backdrop.
avoid: Runs a WebGL shader every frame at full viewport; fifty colours are hardcoded.
a11y: No reduced-motion handling, so the shader keeps moving; the logo is an unlabelled SVG and the button image has empty alt. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black full-screen section under a wide drifting ribbon of blue. A top bar holds three small white links and a dark pill with a red dot. Below, a huge headline reads Unlocking in white over Digital Success in red, with two pale pill buttons and a short paragraph.
behaves: Each block fades and rises into place in sequence as the section scrolls into view: logo, nav, headline, buttons, paragraph, then the service panel. The blue gradient drifts on its own the whole time.
customise: Headline, paragraph, links and service labels are written into the JSX; shader colours and camera values are inline props on the backdrop.
weight: heavy: A full-viewport WebGL gradient shader animates nonstop behind the content.
